mode.description: incremental: only assets new or changed since the last certified run (plus restoring lost metadata); full: redo every asset

allow_data.description: Send sample values and min/max to the model. Off by default: only names, types and statistics are sent

context.description: Business context YAML, relative to maya.yaml

max_distinct.description: Columns with at most this many distinct values get their value list profiled

overwrite_existing.description: false (default): descriptions, sensitivity tags and keys already in Unity Catalog (hand-written or from an earlier run) are never changed; G1 only fills what is missing. An existing description that is empty, a placeholder or too short counts as missing. true: replace them with new proposals

infer_keys.description: Verify and apply keys the describer proposes

key_candidate_patterns.description: Column name patterns tried, verified against the data, when a full-scope table has no declared or proposed key

sensitivity_classes.description: Ordered from least to most restrictive

sensitivity_consistency.description: Columns with the same name across assets get the most restrictive class any asset assigned

model.description: Override the AI Gateway model for this goal's agents
